question: Please list the display names of all the users who owns a post that is well-finished.
evidence: the post that is well-finished refers to ClosedDate IS NOT Null
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
gold: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE NOT T1.ClosedDate IS NULL
gold0: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL

d.request: Please list the display names of all users who own a post that is well-finished (i.e., a post with ClosedDate IS NOT NULL), and also keep the posts' rows that have no matching record in the users table.
d.sql: SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
